entity.name: Gilles D'huyvetter
entity.description: Sole developer and maintainer of iGloo, based in Flanders, Belgium. Builds open source migration infrastructure that lets non-technical Windows users move to Linux safely.

projects.name: iGloo
projects.description: One-click migration from Windows to Linux for people who have never seen a terminal. iGloo shrinks the Windows partition and installs Linux directly from Windows (no USB stick, no firmware knowledge), verifies every ISO against pinned GPG signatures, migrates files, Wi-Fi profiles, browser data and wallpaper, and on first boot installs GPU drivers (including NVIDIA), keyboard layout and the per-monitor display layout. Validated end-to-end on physical hardware with Fedora KDE, Linux Mint and Debian 13, dual-boot alongside Windows 11.
